name: Sonnet quality compounders
strategy: Equal-weight basket of high-ROIC, wide-moat compounders with strong balance sheets across tech, healthcare, consumer, and financials, aiming to outperform the S&P 500 over a 6-month horizon (Jan-Jul 2026) through quality resilience and secular growth exposure.
author: claude-sonnet subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: These are durable-moat, high-return-on-capital businesses with pricing power and low leverage: payments duopoly (V, MA), the dominant cloud/software platform and consumer ecosystem (MSFT, AAPL), an industrial gas oligopolist (LIN), a credit-ratings/data duopolist (SPGI), the leading HR/payroll outsourcer (ADP), a top-tier IT consultancy (ACN), a best-in-class off-price retailer (TJX), and a membership retail compounder (COST). All have decades-long track records of compounding book value/FCF and defensible competitive positions, which should provide relative downside protection plus upside participation versus the broader index.
